mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to be negative due to increased policy tightening costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > (current value + 0.25%) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior month's average (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) of at least 2% is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days, reflecting stronger labor market confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > (current value * 1.02) in the following month
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, average 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than during the prior month's average employment level (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (goods orders) grows by at least 5% over the next quarter relative to the prior quarter, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be positive, indicating robust business demand for equity-backed assets.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > (current value * 1.05) in the next quarter
failure_condition: Quarterly 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior quarter's average when the trigger is satisfied (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 3% predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days due to reduced economic momentum and risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < (current value * 0.97) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the prior month's average when INDPRO declines as specified (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment) falls below 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 5-day forward return is expected to be positive, reflecting reduced labor market friction and optimism.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 3-month average when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in PAYEMS and UNRATE (both above their previous month's values) create a negative interaction that predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return, signaling conflicting labor market signals.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > prev Payne AND UNRATE > prev Unrate
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when both proxies rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 10% monthly drop in HOUST (housing starts) followed by a 2% monthly increase in FEDFUNDS in the next month predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return due to deflationary pressure and tighter credit.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < (current value * 0.9) next month AND FEDFUNDS > (current value * 1.02) next month
regime_hint: Housing contraction coupled with rate hikes
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than prior average when the specified sequence occurs (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent CPIAUCSL inflation above 3%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to risk-off sentiment until the central bank intervenes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior 3-month average when inflation remains above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
